server.framework: Next.js 16.2.10 (webpack mode, Turbopack available but playwright config pins webpack for parity)
server.host_header: 127.0.0.1:3020 (qualifies as local-dev hostname for dev-auth bypass)
server.env_file: .env.local (loaded by Next.js; .dev.vars also loaded for Workers secrets)

dev_auth_bypass.admin_db_flag: ARCHESTIMATOR_DEV_AUTH_ADMIN_DB (set when admin journeys are exercised)

closed_beta.effect: Closed-beta gate is disabled; /signup is reachable; /access-required is only shown when an explicit revoked status is encountered. This matches a pre-recruiting local-preview posture, not a production gated-beta posture.

browser.optional_matrix_env: ARCHESTIMATOR_E2E_LIBRARY_BROWSER_MATRIX (left unset; matrix projects not used)
browser.mobile_checkpoint_viewport: iPhone 15 (393x852) used only for high-value recipient-side checkpoints

storage_state.strategy: Per-fixture ephemeral browser context. No storage_state file persisted.
storage_state.sanitization: Contexts are closed at end of each journey. No cookies, magic links, OAuth state, or session tokens are written to the pack.

data_fixtures.approach: Synthetic local-only data via dev-auth-bypass header + signed-in session created through /login magic-link preview (dev bypass) or through workshop server actions. No real-user data, real client estimates, or real invitation recipients.
data_fixtures.persistence: Local D1 preview via wrangler dev (configured in wrangler.jsonc) when authenticated journeys need D1. State is local preview only.

out_of_scope_evidence: No real email send (preview email transport only).
No deployed Worker, no production D1/R2, no production queues/cron.
No real client portal recipients, no real proposal recipients.
